execution_dependency_note: Execution dependency, not evidence for absent empirical inputs or a new source-blocker closure.
ownership_boundary: B06/B07 own technical cost/lifecycle handoffs; B03/B04 own energy price/bill authorities; B12 validates household full-payable accounting inputs; B14 owns funding/eligibility rule references; B13 owns fiscal consolidation; B15 owns the full financing mix and remains blocked.
admission_boundary: This inventory and structural validation do not admit evidence. The current consumer computes SYNTHETIC_WITNESS only. Later canonical source/evidence review may qualify real inputs under existing E1/E2 policy without owner-per-datum approval. No source-ID string alone resolves that review.

inputs.unit_and_grain: HUF/attributed household invoice; component × archetype × phase × dated event
inputs.reason: Realized full payable cost handoff, payer attribution, VAT decomposition/recovery and overlap remain unpopulated. Policy caps do not supply procurement prices.
inputs.acquisition_route: Consume claim-appropriate reviewed upstream cost/lifecycle artifacts; preserve full and eligible scopes separately.

inputs.unit_and_grain: year/service-life definition; HUF/dates for replacement, O&M, insurance, disposal, terminal receipt
inputs.reason: Complete evaluation-period lifecycle coverage and terminal treatment have not been admitted. Warranty is not a lifetime curve.
inputs.acquisition_route: Bind upstream technical/cost artifacts to each asset generation and explicit dated baseline/programme obligations.

inputs.unit_and_grain: HUF/gross same-invoice subset; programme/revision and nested cap
inputs.reason: Dated B14 rules do not establish project eligibility, awarded support or a household procurement amount.
inputs.acquisition_route: Apply reviewed rule/revision and record-level eligibility allocation to a separately supported payable cost.

inputs.unit_and_grain: gross HUF/meter/interval and physical kWh or reference-state m3
inputs.reason: Complete matched baseline/programme retail handoffs remain Q. B03 MARKET_RESIDENTIAL_FINAL is the only authorized B12 gas layer; B04 frozen gross snapshots do not imply complete annual invoices or future forecasts.
inputs.acquisition_route: Consume full gross upstream bills with preserved meter, allocation, end-use/service scope, physical reference and snapshot basis; acquire the missing market-residential bridge.

inputs.unit_and_grain: net HUF/household/cash period; explicit person/equivalence bridge
inputs.reason: Qualified aggregate income/asset controls exist; a coherent simultaneous household net-income, required-spending, spendable-liquidity, debt-service and dwelling linkage is not admitted here. Release, source-household-base and denominator reconciliation remain Q; a shared year label alone is not a valid join.
inputs.acquisition_route: Review net-income component/period definitions, source release/denominator reconciliation, disjoint expenditure coverage and a defensible representative/calibrated joint estimator.

inputs.unit_and_grain: nominal HUF/dated draw, liability, principal, interest and fee; exact borrower and product revision
inputs.reason: Applicable terms, complete charges, schedules and record-level access/commitment are unpopulated. B14 limits, original envelopes and maximum maturity are rule references only.
inputs.acquisition_route: Admit exact terms and supplied schedules; keep availability/grace separate, APR distinct from coupon, and outstanding terminal debt explicit.

inputs.unit_and_grain: nominal HUF/transfer/event/date with payer/beneficiary and invoice allocation
inputs.reason: No confirmed grant, loan disbursement, VAT recovery or other realized receipt is admitted. B14 snapshot is rule-only and its two inspected intakes were suspended.
inputs.acquisition_route: Bind actual award/contract and dated receipt or explicitly conditional scenario; retain stable fiscal transfer identity and direct-supplier route.

inputs.unit_and_grain: nominal HUF/household/stock date, separately accessible, encumbered and disposal amounts
inputs.reason: Opening spendable cash at the evaluation date and its accessibility bridge remain Q; total wealth is not down-payment cash.
inputs.acquisition_route: Admit component-specific accessibility, encumbrance and date reconciliation, or explicit scenario declarations.

inputs.unit_and_grain: household/person/dwelling target and source grain; weights, uncertainty and scope bridge
inputs.reason: No B12 representative/calibrated inference artifact has been admitted. Exhaustive household microdata is not a general prerequisite.
inputs.acquisition_route: Use existing E1/E2 review: target, selection, missingness, weighting/calibration, estimator, diagnostics, uncertainty, structural sensitivity and explicit validation debt; never infer individual eligibility.

inputs.unit_and_grain: owner-defined floor metric/actor/group/period; HUF reserve and debt constraint
inputs.reason: VAR-B01-CASH-FLOW-FLOOR numerical value and meaning, reserve and debt policy remain Q. Existing VAR-B01-HORIZON-YEARS rollout SCN is not a new missing default.
inputs.acquisition_route: Bind existing policy IDs at the existing owner decision point; keep 12/15/20 reporting, asset life and evaluation horizon distinct.

inputs.unit_and_grain: currency/nominal-real/source price date; conversion factors and explicit rate/time convention
inputs.reason: No discount/valuation or future component escalation defaults are supplied; unbridged originals cannot be relabelled HUF2026.
inputs.acquisition_route: Supply explicit valuation basis, date, component escalation and conversions; next consumer owns NPV/IRR/DSCR with perspective and failure semantics.
